item.title: 'Primary border wall' construction in Big Bend National Park may begin this year: CBP
item.description: The entire 517-mile stretch of the Big Bend Sector is set to receive some sort of border protection upgrade and contracts for wall projects are expected to be awarded within weeks.

item.title: Trump launches flurry of endorsements en route to Texas visit
item.description: President Donald Trump on Friday fired off a flurry of candidate endorsements for primary races in Texas en route to an afternoon visit to the Lone Star State.Trump took to Truth Social Friday morning sending off endorsements in congressional and statewide races in Texas. Notably absent from the endorsements, the hotly contested race for U.S. Senate. item.title: Travis County Fire Marshal’s Office asks for help identifying suspect in arson investigation
item.description: The Travis County Fire Marshal’s Office is asking for help identifying a suspect and the suspect's vehicle in connection with an arson investigation. The county said on Wednesday, Jan. 8, around 8:30 p.m., fire marshals responded to a vehicle fire in the 9000 block of Decker Lane.After investigating the scene, they determined someone intentionally set the fire. item.description: There are some new Austin ordinances: one for targeting loud engine noise, and another for the city to keep its spending in check.One of the things of note is a city audit ordinance. item.description: A sprawling area of high pressure has sent temperatures soaring across the southern U.S., pushing temperatures more than 20 degrees above average for this time of year in some places.

item.title: Texas DPS installs license plate readers across Central Texas
item.description: Earlier this month, DPS installed license plate readers along several state rights-of-ways. Now, we’re learning which agencies can access that data.The City of Austin ended its license plate reader program last summer over privacy concerns. item.title: Former Austin ISD campus being transformed into affordable housing in East Austin
item.description: A former Austin ISD campus that closed years ago is being transformed into affordable housing, with a groundbreaking celebration held on Friday. The school-to-housing redevelopment is officially underway at the former Anita Ferrales Coy School grounds in East Austin. "This is going to be a multi-phase redevelopment.
